meta.about:
What this tool is

An offline companion to the era5-sl-icechunk pipeline. It carries a real ERA5 subset so the multi-resolution behaviour can be explored without credentials or a server; era5_panel_app.py does the same against the live Icechunk store for any region and period.

Data

itemvalue
sourceARCO-ERA5 raw/date-variable-single_level, public GCS
variables2m_temperature (t2m), total_precipitation (tp)
native grid0.25° × 0.25°, 48 lat × 56 lon (36.00–47.75 °N, 6.00–19.75 °E)
hourly base1–31 Oct 2020, 744 steps (serves hourly / 3-hourly / 6-hourly)
daily base1 Jan – 31 Dec 2020, 366 steps (serves daily → annual)
extractionHTTP range reads of the Italian latitude band only — 3.3 MB instead of 50 MB per daily file; 17 568 chunk reads, 0 failures, 0 missing values
storageint16, 0.05 °C / 0.005 mm·h-1 / 0.05 mm·d-1, byte-shuffled + gzip (both far finer than ERA5's own accuracy)
coastline0.5 contour of the ERA5 land–sea mask on the same 0.25° grid (so it is blocky by construction — it is the model's coast, not a cartographic one)

Conventions

  • tp is an accumulation over the hour ending at the stamped time, converted m → mm. Aggregating in time therefore uses sum; max gives peak intensity per base step.
  • t2m is instantaneous, converted K → °C, aggregated with mean/min/max.
  • All spatial means are cos(latitude)-weighted. "Area-weighted" coarsening is a cos(latitude) block mean (conserves area-integrated water); "Subsample" takes every n-th cell and is provided only to show the aliasing it introduces.
  • The AOI time series is the spatial mean computed on the native 0.25° grid, then aggregated in time — so it is unaffected by the spatial-resolution setting (deliberately, so the two controls stay separable). The map and the statistics panel do follow it.
  • Cell areas use the exact spherical band formula with R = 6371.0088 km.
  • All times are UTC.

Review of era5-sl-icechunk.ipynb — the two that matter

  1. Per-file packing is not constant. Each daily ARCO file carries its own scale_factor/add_offset (verified: 5 sampled days → 5 distinct pairs for both variables). Concatenating the virtual arrays along time with compat='override' keeps only the first file's pair, so every later day decodes with the wrong packing — up to ≈ 11 K of error on t2m in the sampled days. This is silent: no exception, plausible-looking maps. era5_icechunk.py fixes it by writing each file's pair as per-timestep coordinates and decoding with them on read (residual error 0.00087 K, i.e. the int16 step). The fix changes what is written, so an existing store must be rebuilt.
  2. No precipitation. total_precipitation was absent from VARIABLES; it exists at the same path and is what a hydrological tool needs.

Seven further items (unconditional recursive delete of the store, os.environ['HOME'], missing authorize_virtual_chunk_access on re-open, serial virtualisation, single monolithic commit, xr.merge(compat='override') masking grid mismatches, unhandled missing source files) are described in CODE_REVIEW.md and fixed in era5_icechunk.py.
